wl.composer.title: Composer
wl.composer.intro: Send a request through the server. Private and local targets are refused.
wl.composer.url.invalid: Enter an absolute http or https URL.
wl.composer.url.targetUnresolvable: The host name does not resolve.
wl.composer.url.unreachable: The target could not be reached: {{reason}}
wl.composer.body.binary: Binary body from a capture, sent as base64. Editing it sends text instead.
wl.composer.body.truncated: The captured body was cut short. Only the stored part is replayed.
wl.composer.timeout.hint: Up to 15000 ms. Empty uses the server default.
wl.composer.redacted: Redacted in history. Enter the real value before sending.
wl.composer.response.title: Response
wl.composer.response.truncated: Only the first 1 MiB of the body is shown.
wl.composer.response.serverNote: Sent from the server, not your browser.
wl.composer.history.title: History
wl.composer.history.signIn: Sign in or open an endpoint to see its history.
wl.composer.history.noSignIn: History is kept for signed-in accounts; this instance has no sign-in.
wl.composer.history.disabled: The composer is turned off on this server.
wl.composer.error.failed: The request could not be sent.
wl.composer.error.disabled: The composer is turned off on this server.
wl.composer.error.timeout: The target did not answer in time.
wl.composer.error.bodyTooLarge: The body is larger than the {{limit}} the server accepts.
wl.composer.error.hopLimit: The target redirects too many times.
wl.composer.error.rateLimited: The server is busy. Try again shortly.
wl.composer.error.quota.userHour: You have used your {{max}} requests for this hour.
wl.composer.error.quota.networkDay: This network has used its {{max}} requests for today.
wl.composer.error.quota.endpointHour: This endpoint has used its {{max}} requests for this hour.
wl.composer.error.quota.other: The request quota is used up.
wl.composer.error.capture: The captured request could not be loaded. Compose a new request instead.
